pattern.name: Quiet terraces
pattern.description: Broad terraced contours turn around the upper-left and lower-right edges with softened right-angle bends. Unequal levels and short step transitions suggest a pressed landscape, rather than flowing waves or feather stripes.

background.status: Selected presentation for the owner-authorized framing repair. Background is independent of the animal and existing website theme.

framing.note: Uniform 90% portrait placement anchored to the bottom. No stretched anatomy or cloned edge samples. Protected feature clearance is measured separately from intentional shoulder entry. This first pass evaluates extraction and placement before any necessary minor side continuation.

matte.calibrationNote: Sampled native exterior matte; connected extraction preserves enclosed eye details and warm ivory anatomy. Only sub-32-pixel isolated threshold residue may be removed; the animal and all retained accessories form one continuous identity.
